title: incident-bot: add oncall SLO-watchers and opt-in slo-toolkit utilities
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds an opt-in SLO watcher feature to incident-bot and companion utilities in slo-toolkit. Motivation: on recent paging storms we discovered teams needed an automated, low-noise watcher that creates short-lived on-call watchers and attaches relevant runbooks and SLO context to pages when a configured SLO breach or burn-rate threshold is detected. This PR implements: 1) new SLO watcher controller that evaluates slo-toolkit summaries and instantiates ephemeral on-call watchers with a TTL; 2) automated runbook linking logic that prefers compact runbook snippets and SLO-correlated diagnostic links; 3) opt-in per-team config and feature flag (incident_bot.slo_watchers.enabled) with sane defaults; 4) observability additions (metrics: incident_bot.slo_watchers.created, failed_creations, avg_attach_latency) and tracing spans for the watcher lifecycle; 5) unit and integration tests that simulate SLO breach events and ensure watchers are created/cleaned up and runbooks attached; 6) migration and rollback notes for operators. The change aims to reduce noisy pages and speed triage by surfacing SLO and runbook context directly on pages. See linked Linear items for rollout plan and canary thresholds.

release_notes: - incident-bot: New opt-in SLO watcher for ephemeral on-call watchers with runbook linking and SLO context. Operators: enable via incident_bot.slo_watchers.enabled and tune TTL/backoff settings. Metrics: incident_bot.slo_watchers.created/failed_creations/avg_attach_latency.
operational_notes: Canary rollout recommended: enable for a single team and monitor incident_bot.slo_watchers.created and failed_creations for 48h. If high failure rate, disable and collect logs. Rollback: disable feature flag and revert config; watchers will expire after TTL.
testing_notes: Unit tests added for controller, runbook attach fallback, and TTL cleanup. Integration test simulates SLO breach events using a test slo-toolkit fixture. CI flake observed on long-running integration test; added timeout guard and retried in CI.
docs_changes: Updated docs/runbooks.md with compact-runbook snippets and added section on SLO watcher configuration. Added deploy/values.yaml defaults for feature flag and TTL.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag: incident_bot.slo_watchers.enabled (default: false). TTL default: 2h. Backoff: initial 1s, max 30s, jitter enabled. Ensure slo-toolkit is reachable from incident-bot to attach SLO summaries.
